name: Thanksgiving
description: A harvest dusk: a big orange moon over a farm with a barn, silo and a house with flickering windows and a smoking chimney, a scarecrow in the corn, shocks and hay bales, and maples that shed leaves into a wind that comes and goes. Geese fly over in a V and a turkey struts through. A garland of leaves and gourds hangs from the header, with a cornucopia and a stack of pumpkins in the corners, a pie-crust edge on the cards and a hay-rope scrollbar. A pilgrim hat on each device on the Map. An unknown new device is a raccoon at the pie, and the whole farm goes GOBBLE GOBBLE GOBBLE.
author: BAMF
